title: 3. Detailed Worldbuilding System (60+ Specialized Fields)
use_cases: Use when developing detailed fantasy or sci-fi world bibles with interconnected lore
Implement when organizing climate, government, and economy data for fictional locations
Configure when defining formal rules, limitations, and sources for magic systems
Use when documenting cultural traditions, taboos, and religions for worldbuilding consistency
Use when tracking historical eras, key figures, and the cultural impact of past events
content:
Create comprehensive world bibles with type-specific fields for every element.

Go beyond simple descriptions. PlotForge provides 60+ specialized fields across 6 worldbuilding categories. Create locations with climate and government, factions with leaders and goals, magic systems with rules and limitations—everything organized and interconnected.

#### 6 Element Types with Specialized Fields

- Locations (10 fields): Climate, population, government, economy, geography, landmarks, atmosphere, dangers, resources
- Factions (12 fields): Leader, goals, methods, allies, enemies, territory, structure, beliefs, reputation
- Magic Systems (11 fields): Source, rules, limitations, users, visual effects, learning method, rarity, cultural significance
- History (8 fields): Date/era, key figures, causes, events, consequences, cultural impact
- Culture (10 fields): Language, religion, customs, traditions, taboos, art, clothing, food, social structure
- Technology (10 fields): Function, inventor, rarity, power source, limitations, appearance, military use

#### Organization Features

- Collapsible detailed sections keep UI clean
- Field counter badges show completion status
- Category filtering for quick navigation
- Cross-reference with scenes and characters
- Export complete world bibles

#### Writer Benefits

- Create immersive, consistent worlds
- Never forget important worldbuilding details
- Perfect for fantasy, sci-fi, and historical fiction
- Build series bibles that span multiple books
- Share worldbuilding docs with co-authors or editors
